name: Orbmancer
description:
There are ten soldiers between you and the Viscount, but you only have a few seconds before he cuts your brother's throat. Your orb glows dully, its many, tightly-wrapped layers of canvas lit from within by the ring you placed there - the one your mother gave to you the day they took her away. You remember the slow, meditative process of wrapping it, sealing its power within each layer. But this is no time for slow meditation. You widen your feet into a ready stance and begin bouncing the orb, pushing it repeatedly, mechanically toward the ground and feeling it snap back up to your palm more and more eagerly each time, humming now with power. The soldiers lunge at you, but you fake left and dart right, skirting their first ranks. Three more you spin past, their blades slicing the air on either side of you. The last - taller than the rest - guards the front of the dais. You throw your orb above his head, run up the length of his armored frame and leap into the air, catching your orb high above the Viscount, who looks up at you in terror. As you slam the orb downward onto his face with a concussion of magical force, you think, "This one's for you, mom."

An Orbmancer brings a unique fighting style to the battlefield, pairing the directness and movement of martial combat with the magical force of spellcasting. They wield an orb they've crafted themselves, powered by a connection to an object hidden at the orb's center, building up energy as they weave their way among foes, then discharging it spectacularly.

The Orbcraft and Orbmancy abilities allow you to create and wield magical orbs. You build up charges of MP in your orb as you handle it while moving on the battlefield - chiefly via the Dribble ability. You may then use your orb as a melee or thrown weapon, discharging the built-up MP as extra damage on impact. This cycle of buildup and release is the core of the Orbmancer discipline, but other abilities augment this, enabling teamwork and even teleportation.

Look, y'all, this one is a "basketball wizard" joke that got out of hand, ok? All the abilities still have basketball-joke names. We'll have to find the heart and soul of this one in playtesting.

Play an Orbmancer if you want to:

  • Craft a deeply personal magical weapon from something that means something to you, one whose power reflects your history as much as your skill.

  • Fight through movement and momentum, building charges of energy through constant motion and releasing bursts of disproportionate force.

  • Control space and distance, using the orb as an anchor for instant repositioning and as a threat that extends in variable trajectories across the battlefield.

Questions to consider when making an Orbmancer:

  • How were they initiated into the craft of Orbmancy? Did they have a teacher? Is it a skill they inherited? Or did they learn on their own?

  • What is at the center of their orb? What does that object mean to them, and how did they come to have it?

  • How does their connection to their orb manifest? Does it change depending on their intent or is it reflective of the object at its center?

  • How do they move with their orb on the battlefield? How do they know when to press forward and when enough is enough?

  • How do others react to their unique style of fighting? It doesn't look like conventional magic and it doesn't look like conventional martial combat. Do they enjoy standing out?

novizio.description: You are initiated in the arts of orbcraft and orbmancy. You have crafted your first orb and have at least some limited experience defending yourself with it.
novizio.baseMpNotes: You can gain MP through your Orbmancer abilities.
novizio.abilities:
Orbmancy, Orbcraft, Dribble.

You may gain an Initiate's Orb from this mestiere or from one of your home cultures, ignoring its Treasure cost, if any.
novizio.gratuiti: A supply of cloth, leather or other flexible wrapping. Athletic clothing, stylish footwear and a headband, if you choose.
